issues.failure_explanation: With the full entropy variables w from Corollary cor:entropy:variables, the left side of eq:entropy_conservation_condition_swe is not zero because w1 contains -1/2 sum alpha_i^2/(2i+1). It equals -1/2 jump(sum alpha_i^2/(2i+1)) avg{hu_m}. In the subsequent computation of the bar-f^{EC,SWE} term, the term jump{alpha_j} avg{hu_m} avg{alpha_j}/(2j+1) is omitted; this term cancels the base contribution. Thus the stated decomposition and base condition are algebraically inconsistent as written, so the proof does not establish the entropy conservation condition via the claimed split.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Include the base SWE contribution with the full w and the omitted jump{alpha_j} avg{hu_m} avg{alpha_j}/(2j+1) term in the bar-f^{EC,SWE} calculation, or restrict the SWE base condition to the SWE part of the entropy variables. These terms cancel and restore the claimed equality.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of Theorem thm:ec_flux is invalid as written. The theorem's flux may still satisfy the entropy condition after restoring the missing terms, but the presented derivation is not correct.
issues.title: Entropy conservation proof uses invalid SWE base condition with full entropy variables
issues.why_classification: The final theorem remains true and the repair is a local algebraic correction to the proof; no new result or global argument is needed.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: where the unscaled coefficients are $\widetilde{A}_{ijk}\coloneqq A_{ijk}/(2i+1)$ and $\widetilde{B}_{ijk} \coloneqq B_{ijk}/(2i+1)$.

issues.failure_explanation: The condition eq:condition is stated for the scaled coefficients tilde A and tilde B. Since tilde A_{kji}=A_{kji}/(2k+1), tilde B_{ijk}=B_{ijk}/(2i+1), and tilde B_{kji}=B_{kji}/(2k+1), multiplying by (2k+1) gives A_{kji} = -B_{kji} - ((2k+1)/(2i+1)) B_{ijk}. The source omits the factor (2k+1)/(2i+1), so the stated formula for computing A_{kji} is wrong whenever i != k.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the relation by A_{kji} = -B_{kji} - ((2k+1)/(2i+1)) B_{ijk}, or compute A_{ijk} directly from its integral definition.
issues.overall_effect: Implementations following the appendix's procedure to compute A_{ijk} from B_{ijk} will obtain incorrect moment coefficients, invalidating the numerical scheme's coefficients and any results that rely on that implementation.
issues.title: Incorrect scaling when computing A_{ijk} from B_{ijk}
issues.why_classification: The error is a local scaling mistake in an auxiliary computation; correcting it is routine and preserves all theoretical claims and the numerical method's intended guarantees.
